params.message:
The review hand leaves with the Vera app

The Vera app is gone, and the gateway stopped serving #agent-vera on
5 October, when its key left the configuration Elixir writes. This takes
the hand out of the release:

- effects/vera.go and its test removed: no review.publish, review.invite
  or review.sign is performed any more, and no vera-seal.key is made at
  boot; /v1/key publishes the gateway's own key only.
- The three review kinds leave the built-in kind table; an action naming
  one is refused as an unknown kind. Replaying old policy versions is
  unchanged: a kind outside the table and a review kind both had no
  radius.
- vera_base leaves the configuration. The configuration is read with
  plain json.Unmarshal, and Elixir never wrote the field, so no carried
  configuration is affected.
- The read-token door and the boot script no longer treat vera/
  resources apart, and the boot script and rehearse.sh no longer fetch
  or carry a vera-token secret.
- The per-action word and the "/*" resource prefix stay: both are
  generic. Their tests and examples now use branch.delete and a neutral
  prefix instead of the review kinds.
- The conformance statement lists three hands and drops the review
  kinds from the in-scope actions, with the hand's dates kept as history.

The records the review hand left stay in the log and verify as before:
a record carries its own action, and no verifier reads the kind table.
